source: 测试版本不代表最终品质
本地运行 | 不上传数据
此程序需要管理员权限；未授权时不会启动。
en: Administrator access is required to manage processes.

source: 看清每个程序，让需要的留下。
en: See what is running. Keep what you need.

source: 搜索程序、进程、PID 或路径
en: Search apps, processes, PIDs or paths

source: 每 2 秒刷新；三个程序页面共用此设置。操作记录始终实时。
en: Refreshes every 2 seconds. Shared across all three lists; activity history always stays live.

source: 单击展开进程 | 勾选保留
en: Click to expand | Select to keep

source: 默认隐藏系统与服务进程；显示后仍受系统保护。
en: System and service processes are hidden by default. They remain protected when shown.

source: 先选择程序或进程，再查看详情
en: Select an app or process to view details

source: 查看它是什么、关联哪些进程，以及为什么被保留。
en: See what it does, its related processes and why it is protected.

source: 父子关系表示启动来源，不一定属于同一程序。
en: A parent process launched its child; they do not necessarily belong to the same app.

source: 恢复已有窗口；只有隐藏主窗口时可尝试显示，没有窗口时查看原因
en: Restore an existing window, try revealing a hidden main window, or see why no window is available.

source: 为这个程序添加或移除程序白名单规则
en: Add or remove this app's whitelist rule

source: 没有符合筛选条件的程序
正在连接本机进程信息
关闭前会显示清单并再次确认；不会自动关闭任何程序。
en: Review the list and confirm before closing. No apps are closed automatically.

source: 搜索已安装应用、发布者或可执行文件
en: Search installed apps, publishers or executables

source: 单击展开组件 | 勾选提前保留 | 白名单页调整规则
en: Click to expand components | Select to keep | Edit rules in Whitelist

source: 与运行中的程序页共用显示设置。
en: Shares the display setting with Running apps.

source: 勾选加入白名单；已保留项目可在白名单页调整，避免误删来自其他规则的保护。
en: Select to whitelist. Edit protected items in Whitelist to avoid removing protection from other rules.

source: 没有符合条件的软件；可以手动添加 EXE 或安装目录。
en: No matching apps. You can add an EXE or install folder manually.

source: 来源、文件路径与扫描范围
en: Source, file paths and scan scope

source: 选择程序或组件查看来源和路径。
en: Select an app or component to view its source and path.

source: 扫描范围有上限，文件未试运行。手动添加仅保留本次列表，白名单规则会保存。
en: Scan scope is limited; files are not launched. Manually added items last for this session; whitelist rules are saved.

source: 单击展开关联进程 | 规则自动保存 | 系统保护始终生效
en: Click to expand processes | Rules save automatically | System protection stays on

source: 记录白名单变更和关闭结果，方便检查未退出或权限不足的程序。
en: Tracks whitelist changes and close results so you can review apps that stayed open or lacked permission.

source: 自动模式优先使用系统显示语言，地区与时区仅辅助判断。更改后立即应用，包括首次引导与所有提示。
en: Automatic mode prioritizes the Windows display language, with region and time zone as hints. Changes apply immediately to all pages, introductions and notices.

source: 使用 Windows 原生材质；关闭后显示纯色背景。
en: Use native Windows materials, or turn them off for a solid background.

source: 设置即时保存；材质效果遵循 Windows 的透明度与节能设置。
en: Changes save immediately. Materials follow Windows transparency and power settings.

source: 包含白名单、外观与列表设置。导入前可预览，原配置自动备份。
en: Includes whitelist, appearance and list settings. Preview before importing; existing settings are backed up automatically.

source: 分享设置：省略本机路径规则，对方未安装的软件不会匹配。
en: Share settings: omit local path rules. Apps not installed on the other PC will not match.

source: 完整备份：保留本机规则，跨电脑导入时默认停用。
en: Full backup: keep local rules, disabled by default when imported on another PC.

source: 不包含操作记录、当前进程和缓存。白名单页可单独迁移规则。
en: Excludes activity history, current processes and caches. Export rules separately from Whitelist.

source: 查看程序与进程关系，保留需要的程序；关闭前始终确认。
en: Explore app and process relationships, keep needed apps and confirm before closing others.

source: 本地运行 | 管理员权限 | 实时记录
en: Runs locally | Administrator access | Live history

source: 不包含进程名称、路径或白名单内容。
en: Excludes process names, paths and whitelist contents.

source: 规则、设置、备份和记录与分享的 EXE 分开保存。
en: Rules, settings, backups and history are stored separately from the shared EXE.
